titleText: Hudson launches internal review following Sports Direct Qormi altercation
mainText: From Times of Malta: Hudson launches internal review following Sports Direct Qormi altercation. Company says injured employees are well and confirms it is cooperating with police investigation

titleText: Labour president downplays row with Abela over foreign workers
mainText: From Times of Malta: Labour president downplays row with Abela over foreign workers. Alex Sciberras says the two sometimes disagree, but 'there was no fighting or yelling'

titleText: PL President believes budget measures unintentionally stirred anti-foreigner sentiment
mainText: From MaltaToday: PL President believes budget measures unintentionally stirred anti-foreigner sentiment. Labour Party President Alex Sciberras believes government’s controversial budget measures targeting non-EU workers have “unintentionally” spread anti-foreigner sentiment.

titleText: GWU condemns assault on workers carrying out their duties
mainText: From MaltaToday: GWU condemns assault on workers carrying out their duties. The General Workers’ Union (GWU) condemned an assault on employees while they were carrying out their duties, calling for those responsible to be held accountable. The incident at Sports Direct's Qormi outlet was widely shared on social media.

titleText: 65-year-old Italian man dies in workplace accident in Ħal Farruġ
mainText: From The Malta Independent: 65-year-old Italian man dies in workplace accident in Ħal Farruġ. A 65-year-old Italian man died Saturday while working at a plant in Triq Ta' Ħal Farruġ, on the outskirts of Siġġiewi, the police said.
